description: This is a test specification file using Playwright for end-to-end testing of the TodoMVC application's 'Add multiple todos' functionality. It simulates user interactions to add multiple todo items and verifies their presence and states.

methods.name: test.describe
methods.description: Groups related tests under the description 'Todo Creation'.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Defines an individual test case, in this case 'Add multiple todos', which includes the steps for testing the adding of multiple todo items.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts the expected conditions during the test, such as element visibility, text content, and checkbox states.

calls: expect(page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'What needs to be done?' })).toBeVisible()

ctags.name: newTodoInput
ctags.pattern: /^    const newTodoInput = page.getByRole('textbox', { name: 'What needs to be done?' });$/
